items.summary: Kathmandu, October 2 Installation of a Bailey bridge has begun at Betrawati along the flood-damaged Galchhi-Betrawati road section in Rasuwa after an alternative temporary track was opened. items.title: Floods drive 33 pregnant women to Kathmandu for childbirth
items.summary: Local maternity clinics and services remain disrupted in Rasuwa and Nuwakot since the August 26 floods. But many women cannot travel to Kathmandu because of damaged roads.
